description: This file implements asynchronous I/O operations using POSIX aio structures, including thread management, work queue processing, and functions for reading, writing, error handling, and preparing aio control blocks.

classes.name: aiocb
classes.description: Class representing an asynchronous I/O control block with methods for construction and destruction.

methods.name: aiocb
methods.description: Constructor initializing the aiocb object and starting the worker thread if necessary.

methods.name: ~aiocb
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the aiocb object, stopping the worker thread if this is the last reference.

methods.name: aio_error
methods.description: Returns the error status of an aio operation.

methods.name: aio_return
methods.description: Returns the result of an aio operation.

methods.name: aio_suspend
methods.description: Suspends until one or more aio operations complete.

methods.name: aio_prepare
methods.description: Prepares an aiocb structure with buffer, offset, and size for an operation.
